SELECTED_INDEX: 8

EXPLANATION: The weak band at 2728 cm⁻¹ is characteristic of the aldehyde C–H stretch/Fermi resonance in alkanals, while the 1727 cm⁻¹ band fits a saturated carbonyl (FRQ-001). The strong CH region at 2894 and CH2/CH3 deformations at 1446/1395 cm⁻¹ agree with an aliphatic chain (GFQ-003). The pair of bands at 1121 and 1074 cm⁻¹, together with the 894 cm⁻¹ feature, are consistent with ether C–O–C stretching/bending modes, which distinguishes an aldehyde-plus-ether from straight-chain aldehydes. Among the candidates, only 8 (CCCCOCCC=O) contains both an aldehyde and an ether, matching all observed features.
